text: DSH Skill Console 为 DSH 网页客户端提供技能浏览与管理界面，并注册 /skills、/skills-uninstall、/skills-update 和 /skills-doctor 命令。技能面板可合并展示发现到的技能，支持搜索、筛选和详情查看；独立管理模式还能从 Git 仓库或本地路径预览并安装技能、更新仓库镜像、卸载受管技能及检查死链、无效 frontmatter 和孤儿镜像。适合希望在 DSH 中集中查找和维护 Agent 技能的用户。管理功能在本机操作技能目录，并通过 Git 获取或更新用户指定的仓库；没有代码声明的 API key 要求。

DSH Skill Console adds a web panel and commands to browse, search, install, update, and check DSH skills. Standalone mode also supports uninstalling managed skills. Git accesses the repository selected by the user; no API key is declared.
想在 DSH 里搜索并查看已发现的 Agent 技能
有没有能在界面里安装或更新技能仓库的功能？
I want to browse and search my available DSH skills in a web panel.
DSH Skill Console 的功能「技能面板」：在主侧边栏和 Settings 中打开技能库，浏览发现到的技能并按名称或描述搜索、筛选，查看技能详情。
DSH Skill Console 的功能「技能维护命令」：通过斜杠命令列出并筛选技能、卸载受管技能、更新一个或全部仓库镜像，或检查死链、无效 frontmatter 和孤儿镜像。
DSH Skill Console 使用前须知：安装或更新技能仓库时会通过 Git 克隆或拉取用户指定的仓库，并在本机技能目录中维护链接；远端地址取决于用户输入。（见 lib/index.js:494-507）

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console：- **Settings → Skills panel** — one merged view of every skill DSH discovers:
  the managed `~/.dsh/skills` root (repo mirrors + local skills, name ·
  invocation · source · path), plus bundled and project-scope skills shown
  read-only, with search
- **`/skills`** — list skills (name · invocation · source repo), optionally filtered
- **`/skills-uninstall <名字>`** — remove an installed skill
- **`/skills-update [仓库名]`** — pull a repo mirror and re-sync its links (default `mattpocock-skills`)
- **`/skills-doctor`** — health check: dead links, invalid frontmatter, orphaned mirrors

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console：For skills managed through CC Switch, set `managementMode: cc-switch`. This mode retains the skill list, search, and `/skills`, hides installation, updates, removal, and health-check actions, and rejects legacy management API calls. The default `standalone` mode retains the independent management features described below.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Why：DSH skills (`SKILL.md` bundles discovered by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`)
ship no UI. This plugin closes the gap twice: a read-only Settings panel
(client half) for browsing, and `/` commands (host half) for reading and
writing. The write commands operate on the symlink layout in `~/.dsh/skills`
(`git pull` + reconcile), after which DSH's watcher hot-reloads the result.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Install：From this GitHub repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console.git
```

Or from a local path or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-skill-console
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-skill-console-1.0.0.tgz
```

Note: `link:`-installed plugins are not watched by HMR, so editing
`lib/index.js` or `lib/client.js` requires an app restart to take effect.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Usage：```
/skills                    # list every skill in this session
/skills docx               # filter by keyword (name, description, whenToUse)
/skills-uninstall pr       # remove the `pr` skill
/skills-update             # update mattpocock-skills (default)

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Usage：The panel lives in the **main sidebar** (the Skills icon, next to Plugins) and
also under **Settings → Skills**. It is a search-centric management console: a
large centred search bar over a full-width card gallery, with the filters
(source / invocation / sort) tucked into a slide-out panel behind the **筛选**
button. Click a card for a slide-over detail drawer with the description,
invocation, source, path, a button that copies its `/name` command, and an
**uninstall** button (managed-root skills only — bundled and project skills
are shown read-only). The header **installs** skills from a git URL or local
path (preview → select → link), **updates every repo mirror** under
`~/.dsh/repos` in one go (skip sets match the preview: a mirror's hidden
directories are hidden in all three flows), and runs a **health check**. The
same actions also exist as `/skills-uninstall`, `/skills-update` and
`/skills-doctor`.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Usage：Each `/skills` line reads `- /name [invocation · 来源:repo] — description`:

- **invocation** — `模型+用户` / `仅模型` / `仅用户` / `未开放`
- **来源** — the repo mirror a symlink resolves into (e.g. `mattpocock-skills`),
  or a discovery-root label for non-repo skills (`内置`, `DSH用户`, `项目`, …).

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Configuration：Override the managed directories on the `skill-console` row in your profile
patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) if needed:

```yaml
- id: skill-console
  config:
    skillsDir: /Users/you/.dsh/skills            # default
    reposDir: /Users/you/.dsh/repos              # default

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Distribution：The primary channel is this GitHub repository (install via the git URL above).
Publishing to npm is optional; if you do, the scoped name requires `--access
public`:

```sh
npm login
npm publish --access public
```

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Distribution：The loader's gate is the plugin's **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges**, compared
against the running DSH version (semver, with prereleases included) — a peer
pinned to one exact release (`0.2.0-rc.2`) turns the plugin "incompatible" the
moment the app moves to `0.2.1-rc.2`. Keep those ranges as `^0.2.0-rc.2`, and
extend `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` (the market's compatibility table) when a
new DSH release has been verified.

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · Layout：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: four commands + the panel's `/api/skill-console/list` route |
| `lib/client.js` | Client half: the Settings "Skills" panel (React) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that mounts the package as one host row |
| `package.json` | npm metadata + `dsh.bundle`/`dsh.client`/`dsh.compatibility` |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | Offline test of `/skills` against fake services |
| `test/manager.test.mjs` | Filesystem commands against a throwaway git remote |

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console：[English](README.md) | 简体中文 | [日本語](README.ja.md)

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**社区插件**，同时提供**可视化技能面板**和**命令行技能管理**：

- **Settings → Skills 面板** — 与 DSH 全量发现合并的技能总览：受管的 `~/.dsh/skills`（仓库镜像 + 本地技能；名称 · 调用方式 · 来源 · 路径）加内置与项目级技能（只读展示），支持搜索
- **`/skills`** — 列出技能（名称 · 调用方式 · 来源仓库），可按关键词过滤
- **`/skills-uninstall <名字>`** — 卸载一个已安装技能
- **`/skills-update [仓库名]`** — 拉取仓库镜像并重新同步其链接（默认 `mattpocock-skills`）
- **`/skills-doctor`** — 结构体检：死链、无效 frontmatter、孤儿镜像

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console：若技能通过 CC Switch 统一管理，可设置 `managementMode: cc-switch`。该模式只保留技能展示、搜索和 `/skills`；隐藏安装、更新、卸载及体检入口，并拒绝旧管理接口。默认 `standalone` 模式保留下文的独立管理功能。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · 为什么做这个：DSH 的技能（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` 发现的 `SKILL.md` 包）本身不带任何 UI。这个插件从两头补齐：面向浏览的 Settings 面板（client 半），以及面向读写的 `/` 命令（host 半）。写命令作用于 `~/.dsh/skills` 的符号链接布局（`git pull` + 对账同步），之后 DSH 的 watcher 会热加载结果。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · 安装：推荐从 GitHub 仓库安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console.git
```

也支持本地路径或 tarball：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-skill-console
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-skill-console-1.0.0.tgz
```

注意：以 `link:` 方式安装的插件不走 HMR 监听，修改 `lib/index.js` 或 `lib/client.js` 后需要重启 App 才能生效。

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · 用法：```
/skills                    # 列出本会话的每个技能
/skills docx               # 按关键词过滤（名称、描述、whenToUse）
/skills-uninstall pr       # 移除 `pr` 技能
/skills-update             # 更新 mattpocock-skills 镜像（默认）

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · 用法：面板位于**主侧边栏**（Skills 图标，在 Plugins 旁边），同时也在 **Settings → Skills** 下。它是一个以搜索为核心的管理台：大号居中搜索框下面是整宽卡片画廊，筛选器（来源 / 调用方式 / 排序）收在 **筛选** 按钮后面的滑出面板里。点击卡片打开滑出式详情抽屉，里面有描述、调用方式、来源、路径，一个复制 `/名称` 命令的按钮，以及**卸载**按钮（仅限受管技能——内置与项目级技能只读展示）。顶栏提供**安装**（git URL 或本地路径：预览 → 勾选 → 链接）、**更新**（一次同步 `~/.dsh/repos` 下的全部镜像，且预览/安装/更新三处对镜像内隐藏目录的口径一致）、**健康检查**。同样的操作也可以通过 `/skills-uninstall`、`/skills-update`、`/skills-doctor` 完成。

`/skills` 每一行的格式是 `- /名称 [调用方式 · 来源:仓库] — 描述`：

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · 用法：- **调用方式** — `模型+用户` / `仅模型` / `仅用户` / `未开放`
- **来源** — 符号链接解析到的仓库镜像（如 `mattpocock-skills`），或非仓库技能的发现来源标签（`内置`、`DSH用户`、`项目`…）

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · 配置：如需覆盖受管目录，在 profile 补丁（`cordis.patch.yml`）的 `skill-console` 行上设置：

```yaml
- id: skill-console
  config:
    skillsDir: /Users/you/.dsh/skills            # 默认值
    reposDir: /Users/you/.dsh/repos              # 默认值

@mi-lu-uncle/dsh-skill-console README · 分发：主要渠道是 GitHub 仓库（用上面的 git URL 安装）。发布到 npm 是可选的；如果要发布，scoped 包名需要 `--access public`：

```sh
npm login
npm publish --access public
```

真正拦人的是插件声明的 **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer 范围**：loader 拿它和当前 DSH 版本做 semver 比对（含预发布版）。把 peer 钉死成某一个版本（`0.2.0-rc.2`），App 一升到 `0.2.1-rc.2` 就会被判「不兼容」。所以 peer 要写成 `^0.2.0-rc.2`；`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`（市场用的兼容表）在验证过新版本后再补一条。

| `lib/client.js` | Client 半：Settings 的「Skills」面板（React） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle 补丁，把本包作为一个 host 行挂载 |
| `package.json` | npm 元数据 + `dsh.bundle`/`dsh.client`/`dsh.compatibility` |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | `/skills` 对假服务的离线测试 |
